BSC17-X02.name: The CorpseKing Ultimate-Gi-Gasha
BSC17-X02.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control three or more "Zombie" family Spirits]

Treat this Ultimate card as Cost 5 when summoning it.

[LV3][LV4][LV5]
The LV1 cost for all your "Zombie" family Spirits becomes 0, and their LV1 cost can't be changed by any other effects.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate-Trigger hits, you can summon a "Zombie" family Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost.
[utb]

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13225.name: The TwinAxeEmperor Gordias
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13225.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Cards in every player's Trash are unaffected by any other effects except this one.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit. When any Spirit is destroyed by this effect, refresh this Spirit.

[LV3] (Your Attack Step)
At the beginning of the step, you can target an opposing Spirit. During this turn, the targeted Spirit is also treated as Cost 3.

BSC17-X01.name: The UltimateExplosion Ultimate-Bazzel
BSC17-X01.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Red Spirits]

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Destroy an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit and an opposing Nexus. After this effect resolves, summon this Ultimate card.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, you can activate one of your Bursts, ignoring the Burst condition. After that Burst activates, you can set a card with Burst effects from your Hand.
[utb]

BSC17-009.name: The UltimateMarshal Ultimate-Lay-Saurer
BSC17-009.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more White Spirits]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (Start of Opposing Attack Step)
You can target an opposing Spirit. During this turn, the targeted Spirit can't attack.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, this Ultimate can't be blocked by opposing Spirits. [Critical Hit] If the hit card is Cost 3 or less, also, this Ultimate gains an extra Ultimate Symbol.
[utb]

BSC17-004.name: Ultimate-Don-Diegod
BSC17-004.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Purple Spirits]

[LV3][LV4][LV5]
Neither player's deck can be discarded from, nor can they increase cores from the Void via Spirit effects.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4][LV5] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)]
When Ultimate-Trigger hits, for each cost of the card sent to the Trash, send a core from any opposing Spirits to the Void.
[utb]

BSC17-001.name: Ultimate-Bladra
BSC17-001.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Red Spirits]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (Your Main Step)
All your Ultimate symbols can also be treated as Red symbols.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit.
[utb]

BSC17-013.name: Ultimate-Gordias
BSC17-013.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Blue Spirits]

[LV3][LV4][LV5]
Cards in every player's Trash can't activate their effects, and can't be affected by any other effects except this one.

[Double Ultimate Trigger: [LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
For each Ultimate Trigger hit, destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit. [Double Hit] When it hits twice, also, destroy an opposing Spirit.
[wutb]

BSC17-006.name: Ultimate-Grant-Benkei
BSC17-006.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Green Spirits]

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Brave's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
Summon this Ultimate card. Then, if a Brave's (When Summoned) effect was activated when this Burst acitvates, the opponent discards a card from their Hand.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, the opponent discards a card from their Hand.
[utb]

BSC17-010.name: Ultimate-Hipogrifee
BSC17-010.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Yellow Spirits]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)
Unless the opponent sends a core from their Reserve to their Trash, they can't block.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, return an "Imaginary Beast" family Spirit card from your Trash to your Hand.
[utb]

BSC17-007.name: Ultimate-Igua-Buggy
BSC17-007.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Red/White Spirits]

[LV3][LV4] (Your Main Step)
All your Ultimate Symbols are also treated as Red/White Symbols.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, return an opposing Spirit to their Hand.
[utb]

BSC17-X03.name: Ultimate-Onikuwaga
BSC17-X03.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Green Spirits]

[LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)
If this is the first attack of your turn, refresh this Ultimate.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, exhaust an opposing Spirit. [Critical Hit] If the hit card is a Spirit card, also, put two cores from the Void to your Reserve.
[utb]

BSC17-014.name: Ultimate-Orion
BSC17-014.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control three or more Blue Spirits]

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4] (When Summoned)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total cost of 12. [Critical Hit] If the hit card is Cost 5 or less, also, discard 12 cards from the opposing decktop.
[utb]

BSC17-005.name: Ultimate-Sekkohkiji
BSC17-005.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Red/Green Spirits]

[LV3][LV4] (Your Main Step)
All your Ultimate Symbols are also treated as Red/Green Symbols.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, exhaust two opposing Spirits.
[utb]

BSC17-003.name: Ultimate-Soulhorse
BSC17-003.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Red/Purple Spirits]

[LV3][LV4] (Your Main Step)
All your Ultimate Symbols are also treated as Red/Purple Symbols.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit.
[utb]

BSC17-008.name: Ultimate-Sunk-Shine
BSC17-008.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more White Spirits]

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this Ultimate card.

[LV3][LV4] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Ultimate can block while exhausted.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4] (When Blocks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, when only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
[utb]

ULTIMATE-SWORDMASTER.name: Ultimate-Swordmaster-Dragon
ULTIMATE-SWORDMASTER.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Ultimates]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] [True-Clash] (When Attacks)
The opponent must block with their Spirits/Ultimates if possible.

[Double Ultimate Trigger: [LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
For each Ultimate Trigger hit, if this Ultimate is blocked by opposing Spirits, send an opposing Life to their Reserve. [Double Hit] When it hits twice, also, destroy a Brave on an opposing Braved Spirit.
[wutb]

BSC17-011.name: Ultimate-Tamamonoin
BSC17-011.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Yellow Spirits]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (Your Attack Step)
All your Ultimates can't be blocked by opposing LV1 Spirits.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, during this turn, all your Spirits with [Holy Life] can't be blocked by opposing Ultimates.
[utb]

BSC17-X04.name: Ultimate-Trickster
BSC17-X04.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Ultimates]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Summoned)
Return a Magic card from your Trash to the Hand.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, return a card from your Trash to the Hand. [Critical Hit] If the hit card is Cost 4 or less, also, refresh all your other Ultimates.
[utb]

BSC17-012.name: Ultimate-Sea-Serpendar
BSC17-012.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Blue Spirits]

[LV3][LV4] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Brave Spirit.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4] (Start of Opposing Attack Step)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, during this turn, opposing Cost 5 or less Spirits can't attack.
[utb]
